req_spec.title: Member B - Editing and priority persistence
req_spec.scope: README.md TF-REQ-009/010/011/018 edit persistence; src/App.jsx updateTask; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx; src/utils/tasks.js and validation.js. Derived refinements of documented rules, not an invented customer SRS.

requirement.title: Prefill the selected task for editing
requirement.description: Opening Edit shall show "Edit Task", "Cancel" and "Save Changes". Task Title, Description, Priority, Status and Due Date shall contain that selected task's saved values; optional empty values remain empty. Reopening or selecting another task initializes from its latest saved object. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-009; Exact messages / Dialog text); implementation: src/App.jsx editingTask and keyed TaskFormModal; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx task initializer; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Commit a valid edit atomically to the selected task
requirement.description: A valid "Save Changes" replaces the selected task's normalized form values, immediately saves taskflow_tasks, closes "Edit Task" and shows "Task updated successfully." Unedited fields and all other task objects remain unchanged; empty optional description/date may be saved. Title and description are trimmed by normalizeValues (text boundary testing belongs to A). Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-010; Storage; Exact messages / Edit); implementation: src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx handleSubmit; src/App.jsx updateTask/commit; src/utils/tasks.js normalizeValues; src/utils/storage.js saveTasks; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Preserve identity and creation timestamp while advancing update time
requirement.description: A successful edit preserves id and createdAt exactly and sets updatedAt to the current ISO timestamp, even when form values are unchanged. With a clock later than the fixture timestamp, updatedAt must be strictly later than before the save. A title change must not create a new task. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-010; Storage / Task fields); implementation: src/App.jsx updateTask object spread and new Date().toISOString(); baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Reject invalid edits without any partial commit
requirement.description: Any validation error keeps "Edit Task" open and leaves every stored task field, including updatedAt, unchanged. Representative failures: blank/space-only title gives "Title is required."; two trimmed characters gives "Title must be at least 3 characters."; 81 characters gives "Title must be 80 characters or fewer."; 501 description characters gives "Description must be 500 characters or fewer." No "Task updated successfully." is emitted. These are edit rejection checks, not A's text boundary sweep or C's enum/date partitions. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-011; Exact messages / Validation); implementation: src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx handleSubmit return before onSave; src/utils/validation.js validateTask; src/App.jsx updateTask; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Recover a rejected edit and commit only the corrected values
requirement.description: A rejected edit retains the entered draft. Correcting its invalid values then choosing "Save Changes" commits exactly one update, closes the form and shows "Task updated successfully." Original id/createdAt remain intact. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-010/011; Exact messages / Edit); implementation: src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx values/submitted/handleSubmit; src/App.jsx updateTask; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Persist priority edits through the edit workflow
requirement.description: Saving a changed Priority through "Save Changes" retains the selected priority in taskflow_tasks, the card badge and the next edit form, including after reload. Repeated priority edits retain the latest saved choice. Query/filter semantics and enum partition validation are excluded. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-018 (edit persistence only); TF-REQ-010; Storage); implementation: src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx priority select; src/App.jsx updateTask/commit; src/utils/tasks.js normalizeValues; src/components/TaskCard.jsx priority badge; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Apply repeated edits and target only the selected identity
requirement.description: Successive edit sessions start from the latest committed values. Editing a task among same-title siblings updates only its id; switching between tasks must not reuse another task's draft. Each successful save shows "Task updated successfully." Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-009/010; Exact messages / Edit); implementation: src/App.jsx updateTask id comparison, editingTask and keyed TaskFormModal; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx task initializer; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

req_spec.title: Member B - Editing dismissal and draft isolation
req_spec.scope: README.md TF-REQ-012 plus code-derived dismissal refinements; src/components/Modal.jsx, TaskFormModal.jsx; src/App.jsx closeModal.

requirement.title: Discard editing through every supported dismissal path
requirement.description: "Cancel", "Close" (X), Escape and a mouse press on the dark backdrop close "Edit Task" without saving any draft, changing id/createdAt/updatedAt, or showing "Task updated successfully." This applies to valid, invalid, unchanged and priority-only drafts. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-012; Exact messages / Dialog text); implementation: src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx Cancel; src/components/Modal.jsx Close/onKeyDown/onMouseDown; src/App.jsx closeModal; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Reopening a canceled edit discards draft and validation state
requirement.description: After dismissal, a new "Edit Task" session contains only the saved values and no previous draft/error state. A canceled priority edit cannot appear on the next edit session or reload. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-009/012); implementation: src/App.jsx closeModal and conditional TaskFormModal mount; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx useState initializers; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Interior modal interaction is not backdrop dismissal
requirement.description: A mouse press inside either dialog must not close it or commit an edit/delete. Only event.target === event.currentTarget on the dark backdrop invokes onClose. Ordinary interaction with edit controls keeps "Edit Task" open until explicit save/dismissal. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-012/015 supplemented by code-derived backdrop hit-test behavior); implementation: src/components/Modal.jsx onMouseDown target equality; src/App.jsx closeModal; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

req_spec.title: Member B - Deletion confirmation and target isolation
req_spec.scope: README.md TF-REQ-013/014/015; src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.jsx and Modal.jsx; src/App.jsx deleteTask. Only normal writable-storage workflows.

requirement.title: Show exact deletion confirmation for the current target
requirement.description: "Delete" opens "Delete Task" with exactly: Are you sure you want to delete "<title>"? This cannot be undone. The title is the current saved target title (including quotes or punctuation), and buttons are "Cancel" and "Confirm Delete". Opening the dialog alone must not remove or mutate any task. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-013; Exact messages / Dialog text); implementation: src/App.jsx deletingTask by modal.id; src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Confirm deletion of only the intended task
requirement.description: "Confirm Delete" removes only the selected id, immediately saves the remaining array, closes "Delete Task" and shows "Task deleted successfully." Every other task object remains exactly unchanged. The deleted object remains absent after reload, including when it was the sole task or shared a title with another object. Same-title setup is not a creation assertion. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-014; Storage; Exact messages / Delete); implementation: src/App.jsx deleteTask/commit; src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.jsx onConfirm; src/utils/storage.js saveTasks; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Cancel deletion through every supported dismissal path
requirement.description: "Cancel", "Close" (X), Escape and pressing the dark backdrop close "Delete Task" without removing or changing any task or timestamp and without "Task deleted successfully." Reopening must offer confirmation for the correct saved task. Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-015 supplemented by shared Modal close paths); implementation: src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.jsx onClose; src/components/Modal.jsx Close/onKeyDown/onMouseDown; src/App.jsx closeModal; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.

requirement.title: Keep deletion targets correct across repeated and mixed operations
requirement.description: Canceling and reopening a deletion, deleting different tasks in sequence, or canceling an edit before deletion shall use the latest selected saved object. A confirmed id is removed once; siblings remain intact. Each completed deletion shows "Task deleted successfully." Basis: README.md (TF-REQ-013/014/015 supplemented by code-derived repeated workflow behavior); implementation: src/App.jsx modal/deletingTask/deleteTask/closeModal; src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c. Code-derived refinements supplement the documented rule; no separate customer SRS is claimed.
